question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund computes an Enterprise Value of INR 26,737.79 lakh for investee Epsilon Ltd. Y1 projected EBITDA is INR 1,875 lakh. What is the EV/EBITDA multiple?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** EV/EBITDA = 26,737.79 / 1,875 = 14.26x. Matches Example 12.6. **The Trap:** 7x would be an under-valuation multiple; 20x over-shoots; 11.50x uses wrong EV. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C, XXI-B, XV all use EV/EBITDA as the most common 'firm-value multiple'. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For Cat III special-situations books, compare target EV/EBITDA with transaction comps from the last 24 months in the sector - trading comps alone understate control-premium on takeover candidates.
